verdict.rationale: Drata's API v2 reference lists 'Create Custom Framework' and 'Create Framework Requirements', 'Create Control' with requirement mapping and comparison, 'Create Custom Monitoring Test', and create/update endpoints for Evidence Library items. Alongside 'List Frameworks' and 'List Controls', this indicates custom frameworks, controls, tests and evidence can be added next to the built-in ones. The evidence is only endpoint titles, so depth and workflow are not shown. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on linking custom tests and evidence requirements to custom controls, UI-level (non-API) documentation of custom framework/control creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
